remarks: Available furnished or unfurnished for long- or short-term lease, and ready for immediate occupancy, this exceptional shingle-style residence presents a rare opportunity to experience waterfront living at its finest. Perfectly positioned on the picturesque Five Mile River with 240 feet of direct water frontage, the property offers panoramic water views, an all-tide dock, and direct access to Long Island Sound for boating, paddleboarding, kayaking, fishing, and coastal entertaining. Designed to embrace its serene setting, the 4-bedroom, 3-bath home features a light-filled floor plan with vaulted ceilings and a chef's kitchen appointed with a new Sub-Zero refrigerator, Wolf oven, and gas cooktop. Seamless indoor-outdoor living extends to a private, enclosed waterfront yard that is perfect for relaxing or enjoying sunrises over the harbor. Modern conveniences include a full-house generator, underground irrigation, and abundant storage. Ideally located within walking distance of Rowayton Village, the Metro-North station, and the scenic roads of Tokeneke, this home offers the absolute best of Fairfield County's coastal lifestyle. Enjoy Darien's beaches, charming cafes, boutique shops, and local restaurants, all while benefiting from a direct commute to Manhattan in less than an hour. Combining an all-tide dock with expansive water frontage, this is a truly rare offering in one of the area's most coveted coastal communities.
